shared_elements: framing lines running along the edge
justification: Both surfaces bear shallow incised geometric linework — a ring/disc form, edge-following framing lines and small squarish panelled motifs — but these are near-universal devices rather than a shared specific motif. The decisive difference is subject: A is an anthropomorphic sculpted figure with head, arms and curvilinear body ornament, while B is a flat outlined depiction of a handled object inside a horseshoe-shaped border with corner panels and a grid, with no human or animal forms at all.
